class.name: SteamInventoryItem
class.brief_description: A single Steam inventory item instance owned by the local user.
class.description: Returned by [method Steam.get_all_items], [method Steam.get_items_by_id], and [method Steam.find_items_by_def_id].

method.name: get_item_instance_id
method.description: Returns the unique Steam inventory item instance ID for this stack.

method.name: get_properties
method.description: Returns dynamic string properties attached to this instance.

method.name: get_property
method.description: Returns a single dynamic property value by name.

method.name: get_quantity
method.description: Returns the stack quantity for this instance.
